pick.reason: The oversized $400 makes the offer readable in two seconds, and the split adapts cleanly to both ratios.
pick.lost: 2 weakens the saving and leaves the portrait bottom unresolved, 3 buries the saving in body copy and leaves an oversized empty band.
notes: Use exactly three sizes per format: LinkedIn $400 149px, headline 61px, all other text 25px; Instagram $400 186px, headline 95px, all other text 31px. This makes the number lead and meets the standard’s three-size limit.
Move the Instagram split from y=810 to y=648; start the offer text at y=704, keeping its left edge at x=72. This closes the empty middle while retaining the headline in the top 40%.
Move the Instagram URL to the bottom-left at x=72, with its bottom edge at y=1208, meeting the standard’s 10% bottom safe margin.
Set the saving to #d9480f, foreground text to #161614, paper to #f7f5f0 and the second panel to #ebe8e0; keep orange exclusively on $400.
Set headline and saving weight to 600 and all remaining text to 400; use headline line-height 1.05 and tracking -0.02em, per the brand and social-card standard.
hierarchy: On Instagram, increase $400 from 186px to 233px and reduce the headline from 95px to 76px so the saving leads at thumbnail size; retain 31px supporting text.
composition: On Instagram, move the offer group up 64px and the panel boundary from y=648 to y=584; preserve the URL position.

originality: Replace the independent headline-and-number blocks with one connected typographic arrangement: on LinkedIn, align the top of $400 with the top of “a time.”; on Instagram, let $400 cross the panel boundary by 48px, with the introductory sentence above it and “off their quote.” below it. Keep all copy verbatim and orange confined to the saving.
typography: On Instagram, reduce $400 from approximately 233px to 186px and increase the headline from approximately 76px to 95px; retain 31px supporting text.
spacing: On Instagram, keep the offer’s three text blocks together with 24px gaps and a shared x=72 left edge.
composition: Move the Instagram panel boundary from y=584 to y=648 and start the offer at y=704; keep the URL bottom edge at y=1208.

originality: Replace the generic headline wrapping with three deliberate lines: “Your street,” / “one roof” / “at a time.” Align the panel boundary with the “one roof” line in landscape and its continuation below the headline in portrait, making the split express the street-to-roof idea.
polish: Optically align the left edge of the $ glyph with the supporting text in both formats.

notes: hierarchy: On Instagram, increase $400 from 186px to 233px and reduce the headline from 95px to 76px; retain 31px supporting text so the saving reads first.

originality: Replace the generic straight panel division with one 72px stepped junction between the two paper tones, suggesting adjoining rooflines; use the same single-step treatment in both formats without adding colours or elements.
polish: Keep the URL and all supporting text at their current sizes and left alignments.

notes: typography: On Instagram, set the headline to 95px and $400 to 186px, both weight 600; retain 31px supporting text.
spacing: On Instagram, move “off their quote.” up 24px to tighten the offer group; retain the URL’s current position.
composition: On LinkedIn, move the complete offer group down 32px so the introductory line has more room above it within the panel.

originality: Replace the square step in each panel boundary with one roof-shaped rise, 144px wide and 72px high, centred at x=660 on LinkedIn and x=540 on Instagram; make the dividing edge carry the roof idea.
composition: On LinkedIn, move the roof peak from x=660 to x=930, retaining y=72 and a 144px base at y=144; centre it over the offer panel so it reads as a roof.
